title: 第23章 师姐我来帮你疗伤第24章 五大仙宗逼宫女皇
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
房间里。
只有窸窸窣窣的声音。
偶尔有低声呜咽。
似乎喘不过气一般。
不知道过了多久。
林云抬起头。
看着怀中无限柔美娇羞的小师妹。
“师兄，我还要嘛。”
柳雪琪不依不饶的，又在他胸口蹭了蹭小脑袋。
“我们来修炼好不好嘛~”
她的眼睛水汪汪的。
一片迷离。
肌肤呈现诱人的粉红色。
林云舔了舔嘴角。
轻轻揉了揉小雪琪的小脑袋。
“乖，听话，等你伤势彻底恢复再说。”
她本就是自己预定的女人。
什么收不是收。
林云并不着急。
反而很享受这个过程。

所以才一直拖了这么久没有成就好事。
另外一方面，其实也是有些顾虑。
因为师姐和师尊那边。
所以林云一直都没有打破这个微弱的平衡。
但是这一次经历大劫。
很多事情他也算是看开了。
我辈修士，和天斗地斗人斗。
本就随时有可能身死道消。
既然如此，何不直面本心呢？
什么繁文缛节都见鬼去吧。
再说了，又不是什么逆天有违人伦。
柳雪琪虽然有些依依不舍。
但是也知道，师兄做好的决定不会轻易改变。
只是忍不住又蹭了蹭。
这才放开手。
林云也是松了口气。
“我去看看你师姐和师尊她们。”
“你自己这段时间乖乖的，别乱走动，说不定风波还会再起。”
林云叮嘱道。
九大仙宗也许不会就这样算了。

说不定会有趁火打劫的。
而且，凰凌天那个老不死可能随时会出现。
到时候要是抓人质的话。
content_en:
in the room.
There was only a rustling sound.
Occasionally there is a low whimper.
He seemed to be out of breath.
I don’t know how long it took.
Lin Yun raised his head.
Looking at the infinitely soft and shy little junior sister in her arms.
"Senior brother, I want more."
Liu Xueqi reluctantly rubbed her head on his chest again.
"How about we come to practice~"
Her eyes were watery.
A blur.
The skin takes on an attractive pink color.
Lin Yun licked the corner of his mouth.
Gently rubbed Xiaoxueqi's little head.
"Be good, be obedient, and wait until you have fully recovered from your injuries."
She was the woman she had intended.
What is collected is not collected.
Lin Yun was not in a hurry.
On the contrary, I enjoyed the process.
That's why it has been delayed for so long without achieving anything good.
On the other hand, there are actually some concerns.
Because senior sister and master are there.
Therefore, Lin Yun never broke this weak balance.
But this time I experienced a catastrophe.
He has looked away from many things.
We monks fight against heaven and earth and against men.
It is possible to die at any time.
In this case, why not face your true heart?
To hell with any red tape.
Besides, it’s not against nature or human ethics.
Although Liu Xueqi was a little reluctant to leave.
But I also know that the decision made by senior brother will not be changed easily.
I just couldn't help but rub it again.
Then he let go.
Lin Yun also breathed a sigh of relief.
"I'm going to see your senior sister and master."
"Behave yourself during this period and don't move around. Maybe the storm will start again."
Lin Yun warned.
The Nine Immortals Sect may not just let it go.
Maybe someone will take advantage of it.
Moreover, that old immortal Huang Lingtian might appear at any time.
If we take hostages then.
